description: Operational SLO targets (issue #71 / #489 Track C). Calibrated from 2 distinct scenario-replay runs of scenario-high-generative-miss-v1 (pooled eligible=40 >= sample_floor 15 per indicator). Unmeasured indicators (reliability.fallback_delivery_rate, quality.semantic_reuse_correctness) and live acoustic/visual metrics remain uncalibrated until representative evidence exists. Each target entry cites the exact #58 compatibility series it was calibrated from, and evaluation applies it only to that series. Zero-tolerance invariants never appear here. This file is deliberately NOT benchmarks/budgets.json: those are per-pull-request regression budgets, these are absolute operational objectives.
